Card Q&A.a: Yes. If you have 3 security, you meet the conditions for both  and "gain 1 memory," and activate both.
Card Q&A.q: If I play this Digimon when I have 3 security cards, do I activate both  and the "gain 1 memory" effect?

Effect: [On Play] If you have 3 or more security cards, trigger ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.) If you have 3 or fewer security cards, gain 1 memory.
